text: raptools began Matlab code 2012 wrote paper (1) Nephrology community assessing added value one biomarker clinical prediction model. worked Professor Zoltan Endre paper. Dr David Cairns kindly provided R code Risk Assessment Plot. formed basis versions 0.1 0.4. Importantly, versions current version errors mine (sorry) Professor Endre Dr Cairns. Since writing paper ’ve come consider metrics helpful. , current version dropped statistical metrics believe poor wrongly applied. particularly, dropped providing total NRI (Net Reclassification Improvement) total IDI (Integrated Discrimination Improvement) metrics. never presented inappropriately add together two fractions differing denominators (NRI) two means (IDI). Instead, NRIs IDIs without event interest provided. Third, provided change AUCs rather p-value change much meaningful. Version 1.03 major changes: * allowed input logistic regression models glm (stats) lrm (rms) well risk predictions calculated elsewhere. * provided outputs addition Risk Assessment Plot, form calibration plot decision curve. * output main functions CI.raplot, CI.classNRI now lists include metrics bootstrap sample well summary metrics. CI.classNRI also produces confusion matrices without event interest (separately). Bootstrapping used determine confidence intervals. Version 1.10 : * addition ROC plot. * calibration plot now uses (best practice) continuous curves (old format now “ggcalibrate_original()”). * addition precision recall curves. * plots can one two models. Version 1.11: * made NRI metrics models optional (use NRI_return = TRUE) get . * changed behaviour “x2 = NULL” possible CI.raplot. effect creating model every probability 0.5. * bug fix. Version 1.22: * addition ggcontribute graph. * changed geom_line geom_step ROC plot (represents data better). * bug fix. Version 1.23 (current): * fixed ggcalibrate_original() default parameter error cut_type specified. * fixed ggcalibrate() axis labels (changed “percentage” “probability” match 0-1 scale). * fixed critical bug lrm() model handling caused errors using Frank Harrell’s rms::lrm() models. * implemented missing ci_level parameter ggcalibrate(). * added flexible smoothing controls (show_smooth, smooth_method, smooth_span, smooth_se) plotting functions. * changes maintain backward compatibility sensible defaults.

title: Statistical metrics with confidence intervals — CI.raplot
text: x1 Either logistic regression fitted using glm (base package) lrm (rms package) calculated probabilities (eg logistic regression model) baseline model.  Must 0 & 1 x2 Either logistic regression fitted using glm (base package) lrm (rms package) calculated probabilities (eg logistic regression model) new (alternative) model.   Must 0 & 1 y Binary outcome interest. Must 0 1 (fitted models provided extracted fit rms fit must x = TRUE, y = TRUE). t risk threshold(s) groups. eg t<-c(0,0.1,1) two group model threshold 0.1 & t<-c(0,0.1,0.3,1)  three group model thresholds 0.1 0.3. NRI_return NRI statistics required (default = FALSE). conf.level confidence interval expressed fraction 1 (ie 0.95 95% confidence interval ) n.boot number "bootstraps" use. Performance slows bootstraps. trialling result, use low number (eg 5), accuracy use large number (eg 2000) dp number decimal places display

title: Statistical metrics with confidence intervals — CI.raplot
text: list following elements: meta_data data.frame thresholds, confidence interval, number bootstraps, input data type decimal places. Metrics Point estimates statistical metrics (see function docs). Each_bootstrap_metrics List per-bootstrap metric results. Summary_metrics table summary metrics confidence intervals (e.g. Total, Events, Non-events, NRI, IDI, AUCs, Brier scores, etc.).
